response.sql: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) AS examination_count FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), fractions AS (SELECT ID, examination_count, examination_count * 1.0 / SUM(examination_count) OVER () AS fraction FROM group_counts), average_fraction AS (SELECT AVG(fraction) AS value FROM fractions) SELECT f.ID, f.examination_count, f.fraction, f.fraction - a.value AS excess FROM fractions AS f CROSS JOIN average_fraction AS a WHERE f.fraction > a.value ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
